![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

When dereferencing `inputs.runtimeSourceMap?.rows`, it is safer to filter out any non-object or null elements to prevent downstream `TypeErrors` when mapping over rows. Use `filter(isObject)` to ensure only valid objects are processed.

```suggestion
  const runtimeRows = Array.isArray(inputs.runtimeSourceMap?.rows)
    ? inputs.runtimeSourceMap.rows.filter(isObject)
    : [];
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When dereferencing and mapping properties from potentially missing or malformed input artifacts, use Array.isArray to safely default to an empty array if the property is not an array, preventing TypeErrors.
</details>

Fixed in 07f26e410. `sortScheduledRows` now returns `[]` for non-array inputs before spreading, preserving fail-closed behavior for malformed scheduler inputs. Verified with the focused scheduler Jest suite and the full local verification set.

Fixed in 07f26e410. `partitionRows` now returns `[]` for non-array or empty inputs, so malformed scheduler input fails closed instead of throwing. Verified with the focused scheduler Jest suite and the full local verification set.

Fixed in 07f26e410. The scheduler validator is now exported as `validateSemanticKgFullCodexShardScheduler` and guards malformed `schedulerPlan` / `inputs`, returning a `scheduler_plan_malformed` fail-closed validator result instead of throwing. Added a regression test for that path.

Fixed in 07f26e410. Runtime source-map rows are now filtered through `isObject` before priority scoring and partitioning, with a `runtime_source_map_malformed_rows_ignored` warning diagnostic. Added a regression test with null/string rows to prove only valid row objects are scheduled.
